lines.en: label amigennight2:
scene aminightgen2
I head home early to spend some time with Ami.
lines.zh: 我提早回了家，想陪 Ami 待一会儿。

lines.en: She's already in her pajamas by the time I get back and immediately summons me into her room to lie on the bed with her.
lines.zh: 我回去的时候她已经换好睡衣了，立刻把我叫进房间，要我躺到床上陪她。

lines.en: We don't talk much but instead just lie there looking at the ceiling for an uncomfortable amount of time.
lines.zh: 我们没怎么说话，只是躺着看天花板，看了久到有点尴尬的时间。

lines.en: Frankly, I think it's a little boring. But each time I go to strike up a conversation and notice her happily smiling to herself with her eyes closed-
lines.zh: 说实话，我觉得有点无聊。但每次我想开口聊点什么，就看见她闭着眼睛一个人笑得很开心——

lines.en: Well, I kind of forget that I was ever bored to begin with and instead just...continue to lie there.
lines.zh: 于是我就忘了自己本来有多无聊，只是……继续躺在那儿。

lines.en: Doing nothing. Saying nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都不做。什么都不说。

lines.en: But it's the most comfortable form of nothingness I've ever felt.
lines.zh: 但这是我体会过最舒服的「什么都不做」。

lines.en: scene black
The two of us eventually pass out, but I wake up several hours later and decide to get back into my own bed.
lines.zh: 我俩最后都睡着了，不过几小时后我醒了过来，决定回自己的床上睡。

lines.en: I always hate sleeping in unfamiliar beds.
lines.zh: 我一直讨厌在陌生的床上睡觉。

lines.en: Before I leave, I make sure Ami is tucked into her blanket and that her alarm is turned on so she can wake up on time and, you know, make me breakfast and whatnot.
lines.zh: 走之前我确认了 Ami 被子盖好、闹钟也设好，好让她能准时起床，然后，你懂的，给我做早饭。

lines.en: I guess that all it takes for me to be a little considerate is knowing I'll get something out of it.
lines.zh: 看来我只要知道自己能捞到点好处，就能变得体贴一点。

lines.en: Thank you for the breakfast, Future-Ami.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，未来的 Ami，早饭就拜托了。
